 Shillong Cherry Blossom Festival 2026: Headliners, Tickets, Dates & Everything Else
 Scheduled for November 20-21, 2026, the Shillong Cherry Blossom Festival brings together artists, music, food and culture under one roof.
 By Vanya Jain 
 Published: Nov 19, 2026 04:00 PM ICT 3 min read 
 Subscribe 
 Share : 
 Cherry blossom trees in full bloom in Shillong | Image credit: Satinder Dhillon/Flickr 
 Highlights
 This year, the two-day Shillong Cherry Blossom Festival brings together an impressive line-up of performers, including Nelly, Boys Like Girls, Alt Ego, and Darshan Raval.   
 The festival will also feature an exciting line-up of activities, including fashion shows, cosplay competitions, fitness challenges, mechanical bull rides, and arm-wrestling contests.   
 November is one of the most beautiful times to visit Shillong, as the city’s cherry blossoms bloom. This transforms the landscape into a seasonal spectacle. Celebrating this natural beauty and the rich cultural spirit, the Shillong Cherry Blossom Festival returns on November 20 and 21, 2026. The two-day celebration brings together music, art, local cuisine and cultural experiences, making it a wonderful opportunity for travellers to explore the region while soaking in its festive atmosphere.
 Also, check out our story on the best road trips to take from Shillong .
 What to expect at the Shillong Cherry Blossom Festival 2026?
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by Meghalaya Tourism (@meghtourism) 
 This year, the two-day Shillong Cherry Blossom Festival in Meghalaya will bring together an impressive line-up of performers, including Nelly, Boys Like Girls, Alt Ego, and Darshan Raval, who will take over the stage on the first day. On the second day, the stage will be graced by Khalid, Swae Lee, Galantis, and Elliot James Reay.
 Other artists and bands performing at the Shillong Cherry Blossom Festival include Adrian C, Bhayanak Maut, Cardo, Chegim Durama, Da Minot, Emes, ESC, Feliz, Gids x Gary Shaan, Gingerfeet, Hame, Isaac, Jessie Lyngdoh, Jupiter, Kamari, Kill Deez Kidz, Langki, Leo Boys, Leonard, Magnificent Obsession, Martin D’Souza, Mercy Is Dead, Napalmic, Nazareo, Scribe, Skylevel, Sub-Tide, Time Noir, Tune Up Channel, and W.I.S.H.

 Beyond the music and high-energy performances, visitors can look forward to a variety of attractions, from live theatrical acts and cultural performances to local cuisine, art displays and creative exhibitions. The festival will also feature an exciting line-up of activities, including fashion shows, cosplay competitions, fitness challenges, mechanical bull rides, arm-wrestling contests, beatboxing and dance performances, along with several interactive experiences for the audience.
 Dates : November 20-21, 2026
 Timings : 2 pm onwards
 Venue : Madan Kurkalang Sports Complex, Lumdaitkhla, Bhoirymbong, Shillong, Meghalaya 793116
 Tickets : Tickets for the Shillong Cherry Blossom Festival are available here .
 Find on map 
 For more information on the Shillong Cherry Blossom Festival, check out its official website .
 Best places to spot cherry blossoms in the city
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by Meghalaya Tourism (@meghtourism) 
 Ward’s Lake : This lake offers a picturesque setting to enjoy Shillong’s cherry blossoms that transform the entire landscape around the lake into pink hues.
 Lady Hydari Park : This park is known for its beautifully landscaped gardens and colourful flower beds. It is a lovely spot to enjoy seasonal blooms and soak in the beauty of cherry blossoms.
 Shillong Golf Course : Also known as the ‘Gleneagles of the East’, this sprawling golf course is dotted with cherry blossom trees during the blooming season, making it one of the most scenic places to visit in the city.
 Umiam Lake : Framed by rolling hills and lush greenery, Umiam Lake houses striking cherry blossom trees in full bloom around the end of October and mid-November.
 (Feature image credit: Satinder Dhillon/Flickr)
